items.title: The Techno-Optimist Manifesto
items.eve_notes: A deliberate polemic engineered to break institutional stagnation—thrilling on energy and abundance, but blind to the coordination traps and concentration of power its own acceleration creates.

items.title: Things Hidden Since the Foundation of the World (Mimetic Desire & the Scapegoat Mechanism)
items.eve_notes: The skeleton key to Silicon Valley status games and online pile-ons: we borrow our desires from models turned rivals, and when rivalry overheats, the crowd restores peace by uniting against a single scapegoat.

items.title: Stanford Lectures on Girard, Stagnation, and the Apocalypse
items.eve_notes: Thiel reads Girard's apocalyptic warnings into technological stagnation and global governance—sharp when diagnosing conformist bubbles, worth questioning when the contrarian posture hardens into its own orthodoxy.

items.title: The Free Press & the Heterodox Media Model
items.eve_notes: Built by walking out of legacy newsrooms that enforced consensus, then tested by the harder problem: keeping audience capture from turning anti-orthodoxy into a mirror-image tribe.

items.title: NYC Housing, Rent Freeze, and Municipal Grocery Platform
items.eve_notes: Captures genuine generational anger over New York's cost of living with media-savvy clarity, while colliding head-on with supply math and fiscal constraints.
